$schema-note: Hand-maintained. Data, not code: nothing under src/ imports this file.
purpose: The guard ledger for the KERNEL OUTBOX half of this package — the
`Event` row, written here on the outbox adapter's behalf because ADR
M0.3 §15 gives the ORM one home and `packages/adapters/outbox` may not
hold it. One entry per transaction boundary, driver-error mapping,
cursor precondition and ordering rule, each carrying the file it lives
in, the EXACT text that implements it (`from`), the edit that removes it
(`to`), and the NAMED cases that were seen to go red (`kills`).
The half ABOVE the store — the ordered identifier, the envelope, every
refusal a producer can hit — is falsifiable with no database at all and
NINE OF THE TWELVE NEED A REAL POSTGRESQL. None of them could have been
written against a double: N01 is about a write that has to disappear when
a later one fails, N02 and N03 about SQLSTATEs a double never raises, and
N04 to N09 about what a real index and a real TIMESTAMP(3) column do to a
page. TWO are KILLED-BY-COMPILER and are counted separately, because a
type error is a different kind of evidence from a failing assertion. The
last is killed by an AUDIT rather than by a suite.
procedure: PROVE THE SUITES GREEN FIRST. Tranche 1's first sweep reported 22 kills
and every one was VACUOUS: the context's dist/ had been cleaned, so every
suite failed to LOAD and would have 'died' against no mutation at all.
The driver runs each suite set UNMUTATED and refuses to sweep unless it
is green, and classifies a module-load failure with no named failing case
as VACUOUS rather than as a kill.
@platos/context-identity-access; replace its `from` with its `to` in the
named file; run `pnpm exec vitest run <suites>` from the package with
DOCKER_HOST and TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE set; confirm a NAMED
case goes red. Then revert and confirm green.
N10 and N11 are run with `pnpm build:v1` instead, and are recorded as
KILLED-BY-COMPILER. N10 is the one that proves the composition root's
`OUTBOX_STORE_SATISFACTION` is doing work: the two adapters may not import
each other, so that assertion is the only thing standing between the two
halves of the seam and a silent disagreement.
N12 is run with `node scripts/arch/sole-writer.mjs` and proves the
canonical-store delegation is load-bearing: without it, the single writer
of the Event row is a package that may not write it.
